div.head: Abt 75
div.ab: Mund þare betstan widuwan eorlcundre L scillinga gebete.
Mund þare betstsan widuwan eorlcundre, L scillinga gebete.
[For violation of] protection of the foremost widow of noble rank, let him pay 50 shillings.
The compensation to be paid for violation of the mund of a widow of the best class, [that is, of a widow] of the nobility, shall be 50 shillings.
[Breach of] guardianship over a noble-born widow of the highest class is to be compensated for with 50 shillings;
Das Schutzrecht über die vornehmste Wittwe vom Adelstande büsse [wer es verletzt] mit 50 Schillingen;
The right of protection over the most distinguished widow of noble rank, [whoever violates it] is to compensate with 50 shillings;
